sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
This chest rig is modeled after a Spiritus Systems LV-119 Overt configured in MultiCam Black.

Beyond the front and rear LV-119 Overt plate bags, the in-game carrier is fitted with several commercially available Spiritus Systems components, including:
- Spiritus Systems Elastic HLT Cummerbund with Spiritus Systems Trifold Shoulder Covers
- Spiritus Systems Micro Fight MkV Chassis mounted to the front plate bag
- Blue Force Gear Ten-Speed Quad MP7 Magazine Pouch secured to the front of the MkV Chassis loaded with three Model 8230 CS gas grenades and a Leatherman MUT multi-tool
- Spiritus Systems SACK Pouch Mk3 suspended beneath the placard
- Spiritus Systems MOLLE Back Panel (Tegris) mounted to the rear plate bag.

Additional equipment visible on the carrier consists of a North American Rescue (NAR) C-A-T Tourniquet, Thyrm DarkVault protective case, Kagwerks Samsung Galaxy S7 case, and a custom Black Division ID patch.
